ei.title: 3번: Cancellation of the Bird Exhibit Move
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: Dear Staff and Supporters, Our plan to move our bird exhibits to a larger space was intended to enhance the quality of the birds' lives. However, we have decided that our planned move is not necessarily a good idea at the present time. In-depth discussions with experts have led us to believe that the move could produce dangerous levels of stress as well as potential health risks for the birds. Not every member of the zoo's board of directors agreed, but we have decided to cancel the move. While this is not quite the outcome we had hoped for, we will continue to seek out other ways of improving our bird exhibits. Thank you for your understanding and support. Sincerely, Zoo Manager

questions.passage: Dear Staff and Supporters, Our plan to move our bird exhibits to a larger space was intended to (A)[enhance / reduce] the quality of the birds' lives. However, we have decided that our planned move is not necessarily a good idea at the present time. In-depth discussions with experts have led us to believe that the move could (B)[prevent / produce] dangerous levels of stress as well as potential health risks for the birds. Not every member of the zoo's board of directors agreed, but we have decided to (C)[cancel / approve] the move. While this is not quite the outcome we had hoped for, we will continue to seek out other ways of improving our bird exhibits. Thank you for your understanding and support. Sincerely, Zoo Manager
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) enhance=향상시키다 / reduce=줄이다 (B) produce=야기하다 / prevent=막다 (C) cancel=취소하다 / approve=승인하다
det.analysis:
① reduce—produce—cancel: (A) 삶의 질을 '향상시키려(enhance)' 옮기려 한 것이지 '줄이려' 한 게 아님
② enhance—produce—cancel: 질을 향상시키려 함 + 스트레스를 야기할 수 있음 + 이동을 취소함 ←정답
③ enhance—prevent—approve: (B)(C) 이동이 위험을 '야기(produce)'하고, 결국 이동을 '취소(cancel)'함
④ reduce—prevent—approve: (A)(B)(C) 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 삶의 질을 enhance(향상), 스트레스를 produce(야기), 이동을 cancel(취소)

questions.passage: Dear Staff and Supporters, Our plan to move our bird exhibits to a (A)[larger / smaller] space was intended to enhance the quality of the birds' lives. However, we have decided that our planned move is not necessarily a good idea at the present time. In-depth discussions with experts have led us to believe that the move could produce (B)[safe / dangerous] levels of stress as well as potential health risks for the birds. Not every member of the zoo's board of directors agreed, but we have decided to cancel the move. While this is not quite the outcome we had hoped for, we will continue to seek out other ways of (C)[improving / harming] our bird exhibits. Thank you for your understanding and support. Sincerely, Zoo Manager
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) larger=더 큰 / smaller=더 작은 (B) dangerous=위험한 / safe=안전한 (C) improving=개선하는 / harming=해치는
det.analysis:
① smaller—dangerous—harming: (A) 새들을 '더 큰(larger)' 공간으로 옮기려 한 것임
② smaller—safe—improving: (A)(B) 문맥과 반대
③ larger—dangerous—improving: 더 큰 공간 + 위험한 수준의 스트레스 + 전시를 개선하는 방법 ←정답
④ larger—safe—harming: (B)(C) 위험한(dangerous) 스트레스 때문에 취소했고, 전시를 '개선(improving)'하려 함
det.tip: larger(더 큰) 공간, dangerous(위험한) 스트레스, improving(개선하는) 방법

questions.passage: Dear Staff and Supporters, Our plan to move our bird exhibits to a larger space was intended to enhance the quality of the birds' lives. However, we have decided that our planned move is not necessarily a good idea at the present time. In-depth discussions with experts have led us to believe that the move could produce dangerous levels of stress as well as potential health risks for the birds. Not every member of the zoo's board of directors agreed, but we have decided to cancel the move. While this is not quite the outcome we had hoped for, we will (A)[continue / refuse] to seek out other ways of improving our bird exhibits. Thank you for your (B)[complaint / understanding] and (C)[support / opposition]. Sincerely, Zoo Manager
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) continue=계속하다 / refuse=거부하다 (B) understanding=이해 / complaint=불평 (C) support=지지 / opposition=반대
det.analysis:
① refuse—complaint—opposition: (A) 다른 방법을 계속 '찾겠다(continue)'는 긍정적 마무리임
② refuse—understanding—support: (A) 문맥과 반대
③ continue—complaint—opposition: (B)(C) 독자에게 '이해(understanding)'와 '지지(support)'에 감사함
④ continue—understanding—support: 계속 방법을 찾겠다 + 이해와 지지에 감사 ←정답
det.tip: 계속(continue) 노력하겠다, 이해(understanding)와 지지(support)에 감사

questions.passage: Dear Staff and Supporters, Our plan to move our bird exhibits to a larger space was intended to ①<u>enhance</u> the quality of the birds' lives. However, we have decided that our planned move is not necessarily a good idea at the present time. In-depth discussions with experts have led us to believe that the move could ②<u>produce</u> dangerous levels of stress as well as potential health risks for the birds. Not every member of the zoo's board of directors agreed, but we have decided to ③<u>continue</u> the move. While this is not quite the outcome we had hoped for, we will continue to seek out other ways of ④<u>improving</u> our bird exhibits. Thank you for your understanding and support. Sincerely, Zoo Manager
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① enhance=향상시키다 ② produce=야기하다 ③ cancel→continue (부적절) ④ improving=개선하는
det.analysis:
① enhance: 삶의 질을 향상시키려 이동을 계획함 — 적절
② produce: 이동이 위험한 수준의 스트레스를 야기할 수 있음 — 적절
③ continue: 이동을 '계속하기로(continue)' 결정했다? 글 전체는 이동을 '취소(cancel)'한다는 내용이라 반대 ←정답
④ improving: 전시를 개선하는 다른 방법을 찾겠다 — 적절
det.tip: 글의 핵심은 이동을 cancel(취소)하는 것. continue(계속)는 정반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① intended=의도된 ② dangerous→safe (부적절) ③ cancel=취소하다 ④ continue=계속하다
det.analysis:
① intended: 삶의 질을 높이려는 '의도'로 계획됨 — 적절
② safe: 이동이 '안전한(safe)' 수준의 스트레스를 야기한다? 안전하면 취소할 이유가 없음. 위험한(dangerous) 스트레스라 취소한 것 ←정답
③ cancel: 이동을 취소하기로 결정함 — 적절
④ continue: 다른 방법을 계속 찾겠다 — 적절
det.tip: 취소 이유는 dangerous(위험한) 스트레스. safe(안전한)면 취소할 필요가 없음

det.korean: ① larger=더 큰 ② potential=잠재적인 ③ agreed=동의했다 ④ improving→harming (부적절)
det.analysis:
① larger: 새들을 더 큰 공간으로 옮기려 함 — 적절
② potential: 잠재적인 건강 위험 — 적절
③ agreed: 이사회의 모든 구성원이 동의한 것은 아님 — 적절
④ harming: 전시를 '해치는(harming)' 다른 방법을 찾겠다? 새들을 위하는 글이라 '개선(improving)'이 맞음 ←정답
det.tip: 새들을 위해 전시를 improving(개선)하려는 것. harming(해치는)은 정반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 enhance와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: enhance=향상시키다 / expect=기대하다 / gather=모으다 / reduce=줄이다, 낮추다 / announce=발표하다
det.analysis:
① expect: 기대하다 — 의미축(향상/저하 아님) 다름
② gather: 모으다 — 의미축 다름
③ reduce: 줄이다(낮추다) — enhance(향상시키다)의 반의어 ←정답
④ announce: 발표하다 — 의미축 다름
det.tip: enhance(향상)의 반대는 reduce(낮춤). expect/gather/announce는 의미축이 다른 오답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 cancel과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: cancel=취소하다 / approve=승인하다 / delay=미루다 / repeat=반복하다 / observe=관찰하다
det.analysis:

② delay: 미루다 — 취소가 아니라 '연기'라서 반의어 아님(함정)
③ repeat: 반복하다 — 의미축 다름
④ observe: 관찰하다 — 의미축 다름
det.tip: cancel(취소)의 반대는 approve(승인). delay(연기)는 취소와 다르므로 함정

questions.passage:

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 move의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: move: (A) 옮김, 이동 (B) (감정을) 감동시키다
det.analysis:
① (A) 옮김, 이동 (B) 감동시키다: (A)는 새 공간으로 '옮기는' 이동, (B)는 관객을 '감동시키다' ←정답
② (A) 감동시키다 (B) 옮김, 이동: (A)를 '감동'으로 보면 새 공간으로의 이동 문맥과 안 맞음
③ (A) 옮김, 이동 (B) 옮김, 이동: (B)는 관객이 눈물을 흘렸으니 '감동시키다'가 맞음
④ (A) 감동시키다 (B) 감동시키다: (A)가 부적절
det.tip: move의 다의어: 장소를 '옮김(이동)' vs 마음을 '감동시키다'

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the final result or effect of an action, situation, or event"

det.korean: purpose=목적 / outcome=결과 / promise=약속 / warning=경고
det.analysis:

② outcome: 결과 — 어떤 행동·상황·사건의 최종 결과나 영향 ←정답
③ promise: 약속 — 지키겠다는 다짐
④ warning: 경고 — 위험을 알림
det.tip: final result or effect = 최종 결과 → outcome(결과)

questions.passage: Our plan to move our bird exhibits to a larger space was __________ (intend) to enhance the quality of the birds' lives. However, we have decided that our planned move is not necessarily a good idea at the present time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: intend(동사: 의도하다) → intended (수동태 was + 과거분사). 'was intended to ~'는 '~하려고 의도되었다'
det.analysis: 동사 intend를 과거분사 intended로 바꿔요. 'Our plan ~ was __________ to enhance'에서 'was + 과거분사'는 수동태예요. 계획이 '의도된' 대상이라 과거분사 intended가 필요해요. 'was intended to enhance'는 '향상시키려고 의도되었다'라는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: was + 과거분사 = 수동태 → was intended(의도되었다)

questions.passage: In-depth discussions with experts have __________ (lead) us to believe that the move could produce dangerous levels of stress as well as potential health risks for the birds. Not every member of the zoo's board of directors agreed, but we have decided to cancel the move.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: lead(동사: 이끌다) → led (현재완료 have + 과거분사). lead의 3단 변화는 lead-led-led
det.analysis: 동사 lead를 과거분사 led로 바꿔요. 'have __________ us to believe'에서 'have + 과거분사'는 현재완료예요. lead는 불규칙 동사로 lead-led-led로 변해서 과거분사도 led예요. 'have led us to believe'는 '우리가 믿도록 이끌어 왔다'라는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: 현재완료 have + 과거분사. lead의 과거분사는 led (불규칙)

questions.passage: Dear Staff and Supporters, Our plan to move our bird exhibits to a larger space was intended to enhance the quality of the birds' lives. However, we have decided that our planned move is not necessarily a good idea at the present time. In-depth discussions with experts have led us to believe that the move could produce __________ as well as potential health risks for the birds. Not every member of the zoo's board of directors agreed, but we have decided to cancel the move. While this is not quite the outcome we had hoped for, we will continue to seek out other ways of improving our bird exhibits. Thank you for your understanding and support. Sincerely, Zoo Manager
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: comfortable resting areas=편안한 휴식 공간 / extra feeding times=추가 먹이 시간 / dangerous levels of stress=위험한 수준의 스트레스 / larger living spaces=더 넓은 생활 공간
det.analysis:
① comfortable resting areas: 편안한 휴식 공간은 취소 이유가 될 수 없음
② extra feeding times: 먹이 시간은 문맥과 무관
③ dangerous levels of stress: 이동이 위험한 수준의 스트레스와 건강 위험을 야기할 수 있음 → 취소의 이유 ←정답
④ larger living spaces: 더 넓은 공간은 긍정적이라 취소 이유와 반대
det.tip: the move could produce __________ as well as potential health risks → 부정적 결과 dangerous levels of stress

questions.passage: Dear Staff and Supporters, Our plan to move our bird exhibits to a larger space was intended to enhance the quality of the birds' lives. However, we have decided that our planned move is __________ at the present time. In-depth discussions with experts have led us to believe that the move could produce dangerous levels of stress as well as potential health risks for the birds. Not every member of the zoo's board of directors agreed, but we have decided to cancel the move. While this is not quite the outcome we had hoped for, we will continue to seek out other ways of improving our bird exhibits. Thank you for your understanding and support. Sincerely, Zoo Manager
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: not necessarily a good idea=반드시 좋은 생각은 아닌 / clearly the safest choice=분명히 가장 안전한 선택 / the only way forward=유일한 진행 방법 / required by the new law=새 법이 요구하는
det.analysis:
① not necessarily a good idea: 계획된 이동이 '반드시 좋은 생각은 아니다'라고 판단해 결국 취소함 ←정답
② clearly the safest choice: 안전한 선택이라면 취소하지 않았을 것 — 반대
③ the only way forward: 유일한 방법이라면 취소할 수 없음 — 반대
④ required by the new law: 법 이야기는 본문에 없음
det.tip: 이동을 취소하는 흐름 → 이동이 not necessarily a good idea(반드시 좋은 생각은 아님)
